title: Purchase Option on Units Leased under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Purchase Option Terms — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Term 1 — Quote.** A purchase quote can be issued only while the unit status is in service or termination requested, as the unit's record shows.

**Term 2 — Signer.** The purchase takes effect only when a named authorized signer has completed the purchase option request for the unit; the evidence is the system record of that request for that unit.

**Term 3 — Price.** The purchase price is the book value plus the purchase option fee plus the title transfer fee plus sales tax at the unit's purchase sales tax rate on the book value plus the purchase option fee, plus any charges due. The sales tax is figured on the book value and the purchase option fee together and rounded to the nearest cent; the title transfer fee and the charges due are not taxed.

**Term 4 — Quote validity.** A quote is honoured through the purchase quote period in calendar days after the quote date.

**Term 5 — Title.** Title is transferred within the title transfer period in business days after the purchase funds clear, electronically where the title state supports it and otherwise by mailing the signed-off title, and the schedule then closes.

## Price worked through (hypothetical inputs)

Book value 12000.00, purchase option fee 150.00, title transfer fee 75.00, purchase sales tax rate 6.0 percent, charges due 210.40.

| Part | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Book value | as recorded | 12000.00 |
| Purchase option fee | as scheduled | 150.00 |
| Title transfer fee | as scheduled | 75.00 |
| Sales tax | 6.0 percent of 12150.00 | 729.00 |
| Charges due | as recorded | 210.40 |
| Purchase price | total | 13164.40 |

## Status test

| Unit status | Quote may be issued |
|---|---|
| In service | Yes |
| Termination requested | Yes |
| Any other status | No |
